data.name: SCP RP
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

This is a multiplayer roleplay game set inside a secret containment facility inspired by the SCP universe. Players take on different roles within the facility and interact with each other in a dynamic environment shaped by both player decisions and AI-controlled characters.

Roles and Gameplay

Players choose or are assigned roles that define their responsibilities and gameplay:

  • Scientists conduct experiments on anomalies and analyze results

  • Security Personnel patrol the facility, enforce rules, and respond to threats

  • D-Class perform dangerous tasks and are used during testing procedures

Each role has different objectives, access levels, and available equipment. Gameplay is driven by interaction between these roles.

Core Gameplay Loop

There is no fixed storyline. Instead, each session develops dynamically:

  • Players receive or assign tasks based on their role

  • Scientists perform experiments using D-Class subjects

  • Security monitors activity and maintains order

  • Unexpected events, such as containment breaches, disrupt normal operations

  • Players must react and adapt to changing situations

This creates a replayable experience where no two sessions play out the same way.

AI-Driven Systems

The facility is supported by AI-controlled characters that simulate activity within the world:

  • AI scientists perform experiments autonomously

  • AI guards patrol and react to threats

  • AI D-Class carry out assigned tasks

These systems ensure that the environment remains active, even with a low number of players.

Character Progression

Players can progress through the facility hierarchy:

  • Gain higher ranks and responsibilities

  • Unlock access to restricted areas

  • Receive better equipment and authority over other roles

Progression is based on player behavior, participation, and roleplay rather than a traditional leveling system.

Game Mechanics

  • Gunplay system for combat and security situations

  • Inventory system for managing items such as keycards, tools, and weapons

  • Task-based system that replaces traditional quests

  • First-person and third-person perspective switching

  • Interaction system for objects, doors, and other players

Challenges

  • Containment breaches that introduce hostile threats

  • Conflicts between players and roles

  • Managing limited resources and access permissions

  • Coordinating actions under pressure

Multiplayer

The game is designed as a multiplayer experience:

  • Supports dedicated and player-hosted servers

  • Sessions are persistent and driven by player interaction

  • Gameplay scales based on player count and AI activity

Playtime and Replayability

There is no fixed campaign length. Each session varies depending on player decisions, role distribution, and dynamic events, making the experience highly replayable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel/AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Six-core Intel/AMD, 3.0 GHz+ (e.g., Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence within a fictional setting. Players may use firearms and other means to engage in combat, particularly during security situations or containment breaches.

The game may include:

Violence against human characters (e.g. shooting, combat scenarios)
Depictions of imprisonment (e.g. D-Class subjects within the SCP setting)
Dark themes related to experimentation and containment

There is no depiction of sexual content, sexual assault, or explicit self-harm.

All content is presented in a fictional and non-realistic context.
